name: OpenPresentation Partner Demo
description: A five-slide walkthrough of the published OpenPresentation workflow. Chart figures are illustrative sample data.
purpose: Demonstrate the working presentation workflow and discuss a focused customer pilot.

slides.title: OpenPresentation
slides.subtitle: A shared presentation format for people and AI tools
slides.text: Create a deck, refine it in the browser, and deliver an editable PowerPoint file.
slides.notes: Open with the live workflow. The deck is an ordinary OPF JSON document. Source: https://www.openpresentation.org/

slides.title: People keep control of the presentation
items: Edit the words directly on the slide.
Undo a change and restore it with redo.
Keep the source as a portable JSON file.
Export PowerPoint from the same document.
slides.notes: Use this slide for the live edit. Change the title to People stay in control, then undo and redo. Sources: https://www.pptx.gallery/editor and https://www.pptx.dev/author

slides.title: Structured data stays editable
slides.subtitle: Illustrative sample data, not company results
slides.notes: These numbers are fictional and only demonstrate editable tables and charts. This is not company performance or customer traction.

slides.title: Three public sites, one workflow

rows: Shared design catalog and visual editor
Author and Inspector, with optional hosted services

slides.notes: The local authoring and export workflow needs no API key. Hosted AI and persistence are separate services. Sources: https://www.openpresentation.org/ https://www.pptx.gallery/ https://www.pptx.dev/

slides.title: A focused customer pilot
slides.subtitle: Proposal for discussion
items: Choose one recurring presentation, such as a customer update.
Agree on the source content and design choices.
Review the result with its real author and recipient.
Measure preparation time and the edits still needed.
slides.notes: This is a proposed next step, not a committed schedule or a claim of measured savings.
